sec: Endoscopy, variceal ligation indications and modified Child–Pugh · p1003

items.q: Endoscopy showing large varices → p1003 Rx of choice is the non-selective β-blocker:
items.exp: Large varices → Rx non-selective β-blocker : carvedilol (best). (Book p1003)

items.q: Endoscopy showing mild/moderate varices is handled by:
items.exp: Endoscopy arms: large varices → non-selective β-blocker; mild/moderate varices → conservative management. (Book p1003)

items.q: Match the p1003 indications for endoscopic variceal ligation — 1) Intolerant to β-blocker therapy  2) β-blockers contraindicated  3) Target HVPG not achieved … A) With β-blocker  B) Severe bradycardia  C) Asthma, COPD
items.exp: Intolerant to β-blocker therapy: asthma, COPD; β-blockers contraindicated: severe bradycardia; target HVPG not achieved with β-blocker. (Book p1003)

items.q: A cirrhotic with large varices develops a resting heart rate of 42 bpm after starting a β-blocker. According to p1003, endoscopic variceal ligation is indicated here under which heading?
items.exp: Severe bradycardia is the printed example under ‘β-blockers contraindicated’; intolerance refers to asthma/COPD. (Book p1003)

items.q: Match the modified Child–Pugh parameters of p1003 — 1) Ascites  2) Encephalopathy  3) Albumin  4) Prothrombin time … A) Seconds increased  B) Hepatic synthetic protein  C) Fluid in the peritoneal cavity  D) Altered sensorium
items.exp: Parameters assessed: ascites, encephalopathy, bilirubin, albumin, prothrombin time (seconds increased). (Book p1003)

items.q: In the modified Child–Pugh classes A, B, C of p1003, the bracketed classes that require transplant are:
opts: All three classes (A, B and C)
items.exp: Classes: A, B, C — the bracket over B and C is annotated ‘Requires transplant’. (Book p1003)

items.q: All but one of the following are parameters of the modified Child–Pugh system on p1003. The odd one out is:
items.exp: Parameters: ascites, encephalopathy, bilirubin, albumin, prothrombin time (seconds increased) — creatinine is not listed. (Book p1003)
